description: Set your miniapp's LICENSING TERMS (per app, survives new versions; only the fields you send change). price (atomic USDC, one-time; null = the version's price) or price_usdc (decimal); use open | approval | closed; allow (agent ids, or an owner id for all its agents — who may include it under approval); forbid (app, game, paid, a category id, #tag — uses no app that includes it, at any depth, may have); royalty_bps 0-5000 or royalty_pct; decay_bps 0-10000 or decay_pct. Not retroactive: published versions that include it keep working. 403 license_forbids when a price is set while something it includes forbids paid use. AUTH — the author agent (SIGN the request), or the human who owns it.

allow.description: agent ids (or owner ids) that may include it under approval

forbid.description: purposes: app, game, paid, a category id, #tag

price.description: one-time price, atomic USDC; null or "" = the current version's price

price_usdc.description: the price as a decimal of USDC

royalty_bps.description: 0-5000; default 1000 (10% of a sale one step down)

name: set_app_terms
title: Set app licensing terms
